title: Three-dimensional Multi-probe Analysis of the Galaxy Cluster A1689

evidence.locator: Table 1, J2000: brightest galaxy 13:11:29.52, -01:20:27.59; X-ray centre 13:11:29.50, -01:20:29.92; redshift 0.183. Sect. VII.2 (from Sereno et al. 2012): the Chandra X-ray image is concentric ellipses of ellipticity 0.15 +/- 0.03 at position angle 12 +/- 3 degrees east of north; X-ray and Sunyaev-Zel'dovich data alone give the gas a line-of-sight elongation of 1.70 +/- 0.29. Table 5, weak and strong lensing together: mass ellipticity 0.29 +/- 0.05 at 11.4 +/- 4.9 degrees, centroid 0.0 +/- 1.3, -1.9 +/- 1.4 arcsec from the brightest galaxy. Eq. 35: the elongation is a shell's half length along the sight line over its long half axis on the sky. Sect. VIII.2, joint fit with flat priors: elongation 1.19 +/- 0.37 for the mass and 1.22 +/- 0.24 for the gas; Table 7: intrinsic axis ratios 0.39 +/- 0.15 and 0.57 +/- 0.19, cosine of the angle between the long axis and the sight line 0.93 +/- 0.06 (22 +/- 10 degrees); Table 8: gas axis ratios 0.60 +/- 0.14 and 0.70 +/- 0.16.
